findings.authority: Diário da República - Portaria n.º 281/2019 (30 Aug 2019, DR 1.ª série n.º 166, pp.70-73), amended by Portaria n.º 163/2021 (29 Jul 2021)
findings.version: Original 2019 text retrieved from DR (official). Consolidated text incl. 163/2021 read only from ANTRAM PDF (SECONDARY, association) - official consolidated page diariodarepublica.pt is JS-only.
findings.finding: Art.2: tank vehicles carrying dangerous goods banned 00-24 on Sundays and national holidays on the whole mainland public road network; [163/2021, secondary consolidated:] not applicable to national holidays falling on Saturday or Monday. Art.3: other orange-plated heavy DG vehicles banned 18-21 on Fridays, Sundays, national holidays and holiday eves on EN6 Lisboa-Cascais, EN10 Infantado-VFX, EN14 Maia-Braga, IC1 Coimbrões-Miramar, EN209 Porto-Gondomar, EN1 Carvalhos-Gaia, EN101 Braga-Vila Verde, IC4/EN125 S.João da Venda-Faro, EN125 Faro-Olhão; art.3(2) tank vehicles also 18-21 Fridays and holiday eves on these roads. Art.4: Mondays 07-10 (except Jul/Aug) inbound Lisbon/Porto on A1, A5, A8, IC19, EN6, EN10, IC22, A3, A4, A28, EN13, EN209, EN222, A20. Art.5: Ponte 25 de Abril only 02-05. Art.7 exemptions (health units, armed forces/police, airport/port fuel, ANEPC air bases [163/2021], refineries/ships, LNG UAG, strategic reserves; strikes, civil-protection alert, energy crisis). Art.8 IMT special authorisations. Dec 2026 national holidays (Tue 1 Dec, Tue 8 Dec, Fri 25 Dec - holiday list from Código do Trabalho art.234, NOT retrieved) -> full-day art.2 bans + Sundays; eves 30 Nov, 7 Dec, 24 Dec 18-21 on art.3 roads.
findings.classification_note: Base 2019 text official; the 163/2021 Saturday/Monday holiday carve-out is UNVERIFIED from a primary source.
